title: Heart's Choice
next_chapter_hook: When Chen Ji's fingers touched the forbidden fourth light, the entire Tianji Record burst open—and the gaze of the Heavenly Eye crystallized into eternal fear in the same instant.

text.content: The tremor came without warning, as if an invisible hand was violently stirring within his chest. Chen Ji下意识 pressed against the yellowed fragment in his arms; beneath the ancient cover of the Tianji Record, something was scorching hot as if to sear through his flesh. He lowered his gaze to find between those broken pages a faint blue light slowly awakening, like an eye opening in the abyss.

dialogue.content: Interesting. Three dead ends before you, yet you still have the leisure to touch the forbidden? Chen Ji, do you truly believe there exists a fourth path in this world?

text.content: Chen Ji did not answer; his consciousness had been completely devoured by that azure light. Within that radiance, the phantoms of three paths appeared once more—the left was eternal power promised by Heavenly Dao's will, the right was the path of mutual destruction with Heavenly Dao, and straight ahead lay the abyss of reincarnation filled with wailing souls. Yet at this moment, his gaze was firmly locked on the fourth path. It was a road he had never seen before, blurred as if deliberately erased by some force, yet real enough to make his Heavenly Spirit Root tremble.

dialogue.content: That is not a path, child. That is a dead end. The voice of the Heavenly Eye suddenly gained a weighty undertone, like undercurrents moving beneath a calm lake. The Tianji Record granted you the power of foresight, yet you wish to use this power to spy upon my flaws? The chess game of this world has always been under my control.

text.content: Is that so? Chen Ji finally spoke, a faint, cold arc forming at the corner of his lips. His voice was very soft, like a candle flame about to extinguish in deep winter, yet the chill within it caused the surrounding air to freeze into frost. He slowly raised his head; those eyes that had always been full of timidity now resembled two bottomless ancient wells, reflecting the interwoven threads of fate. Heavenly Dao Master, I have noted this. You just said the chess game is only within your grasp—this phrase, I too have noted for many years.

choice.prompt: Three paths of destiny lie before Chen Ji, the fourth light of the Tianji Record burning on the forbidden page. How will he choose?

choices.description: Accept the temptation of Heavenly Dao's power, control the Three Realms as heir, and become the new Chess Player.
choices.visible_cost: Lose self-will and become an extension of Heavenly Dao
choices.visible_reward: Gain absolute power to manipulate destiny
choices.risk_hint: Lose everyone you care about, including your sister Chen Nian
choices.process_label: Chen Ji gazes at power's phantom

text.content: The phantom of power unfolded before Chen Ji's eyes—a sacred staircase paved with gold and silver, extending upward infinitely. Yet just as he was about to step forward, the image of Chen Nian imprisoned and Su Qingyao standing alone guarding the Tianqing Sect flashed through his mind—if he became Heavenly Dao, all of this would lose its meaning.

choices.description: Choose the path of destruction, dragging Heavenly Dao into eternal void at the cost of your own annihilation.
choices.visible_cost: Lose your life and abandon all unfinished bonds
choices.visible_reward: Heavenly Dao's will will annihilate with you in the void
choices.risk_hint: The Heavenly Eye may have long been on guard; mutual destruction may come to naught
choices.process_label: Chen Ji gazes at abyss of destruction

text.content: The entrance to the path of destruction was a patch of漆黑 void, with no light and no sound. Chen Ji felt a strange attraction, as if with one leap, everything would end. Yet just then, a sigh from Master Mo's remnant soul within the Tianji Record sounded: 'This is not the true answer, chess piece.'

choices.description: Refuse to become a chess piece and refuse mutual destruction, shake Heavenly Dao's order with a mortal body and establish new rules.
choices.visible_cost: Opposing Heavenly Dao with a mortal body makes success extremely unlikely
choices.visible_reward: If successful, the laws of the Three Realms will be completely rewritten
choices.risk_hint: The Heavenly Eye will never sit by as you shatter its rules
choices.process_label: Chen Ji gazes at the blurry fourth path

text.content: The phantom of the fourth path gradually clarified before Chen Ji's eyes. It was not a paved road, but a chaotic blankness—no rules, no order, everything could be shaped. This was a possibility he had never imagined: reshaping Heavenly Dao with a mortal body, rather than replacing or destroying it.

dialogue.content: Your gaze has changed, Chen Ji. The Heavenly Eye's voice turned ice-cold, like a blade forged from ten-thousand-year-old frozen ice. Wish to shatter Heavenly Dao? Hahahaha... Through countless ages, numerous prophets have thought as you do. Among them were those stronger than you, smarter than you, closer to the truth than you—yet in the end, they all became remnants on the chessboard. What makes you think you will be different?

text.content: What makes me? Chen Ji let out a low laugh, the sound echoing through the empty space of consciousness with an indescribable quality. He slowly raised his right hand, and an ancient rune materialized in his palm—the final trump card he had prepared over years, never before动用. Heavenly Dao Master, you are right; I indeed should not think myself different. But you forgot one thing. He paused, his eyes suddenly becoming incomparably sharp. Yet you are not so different either.

dialogue.content: ...What do you mean? For the first time,fluctuation appeared in the Heavenly Eye's voice; the sea of will that had been calm for millions of years rippled.

text.content: Chen Ji did not answer, merely gently flipping his palm. That rune slowly rotated in the air, refracting rainbow light. At the same time, the fourth light on the forbidden page suddenly surged, like a dormant celestial dragon finally breaking its chains. That light attacked no one, yet wove a massive net in the air, firmly locking the projection of the Heavenly Eye within it.

choice.prompt: The fourth light becomes a cage; the Heavenly Eye shows signs of wavering for the first time. How will Chen Ji close the net?

choices.description: Take the opportunity to interrogate the complete truth of the Tianji Record, and the whereabouts and fate of his sister Chen Nian.
choices.visible_cost: Consumes a large amount of Heavenly Fate Value, and Heavenly Dao may lie
choices.visible_reward: Obtain key intelligence to provide basis for subsequent schemes
choices.risk_hint: The truth of Heavenly Dao's words is hard to distinguish; may be misled
choices.process_label: Chen Ji presses rune to Eye of Heaven

text.content: The moment the rune touched the Heavenly Dao projection, an enormous stream of information surged into Chen Ji's mind. These were memory fragments of all prophets throughout the ages—one figure bore a seven-tenths resemblance to Chen Nian.

choices.description: Seize the moment when the Heavenly Eye is unprepared, completely seal it within the forbidden page, and eliminate future troubles.
choices.visible_cost: Requires consuming all Heavenly Fate Value; may faint on the spot
choices.visible_reward: Heavenly Dao's will sealed; temporarily dominate the order of the Three Realms
choices.risk_hint: The sealing may be incomplete; Heavenly Dao may break free at any time
choices.process_label: Chen Ji fully unfurls Heavenly Record

text.content: All pages of the Tianji Record ignited simultaneously, transforming into a brilliant pillar of light shooting straight to the heavens. When the light dispersed, the projection of the Heavenly Eye was already shattered, leaving only an angry and unwilling howl echoing in the void: 'Chen Ji! You will regret this!'

choices.description: Use the sealing as leverage, negotiate new laws of coexistence with the Heavenly Eye, and establish balance.
choices.visible_cost: Heavenly Dao may agree superficially but scheme secretly
choices.visible_reward: Gain breathing space; first rescue Chen Nian
choices.risk_hint: Negotiating with a tiger; Heavenly Dao was never one to keep agreements
choices.process_label: Chen Ji suspends rune above Eye of Heaven

text.content: Chen Ji's voice was calm as discussing the weather: 'Heavenly Dao Master, I have no intention of destroying you, nor replacing you. I only want my sister back, and a life not arbitrarily manipulated by you.' The projection of the Heavenly Eye trembled violently, seemingly weighing the pros and cons.

At this moment, a faint yet familiar soul fluctuation came from deep within the forbidden page. That voice was old and weary, yet carried a trace of relieved laughter: 'Well done, child. You have finally taken the first step.' It was Master Mo. The mysterious existence who had guarded the Tianji Record for countless years in remnant soul form, for the first time actively established contact with Chen Ji.

dialogue.content: Chen Xuan also stood here once, facing the same choice. He chose the second path, attempting mutual destruction. But he failed; his soul was devoured by the Tianji Record, leaving only me, this remnant soul, to continue the vigil. Master Mo's voice carried infinite vicissitudes. And you, my inheritor, you chose the fourth path—shatter Heavenly Dao and reshape order. This was something even Chen Xuan dared not imagine.

text.content: Chen Ji listened quietly, his expression unchanged. He had long pieced together Chen Xuan's fate trajectory from various clues—the ancestor known as the legitimate inheritor of the Tianji Record had ultimately become a sacrifice for Heavenly Dao. And he was merely retracing a path countless had walked, yet none had traversed. The difference was, he held a trump card no one had ever discovered.

choice.prompt: Master Mo's remnant soul appears for the first time, revealing Chen Xuan's fate. How will Chen Ji respond?

choices.text: Inquire About the Complete Form of the Tianji Record
choices.description: Ask Master Mo how to gather all the fragments of the Tianji Record, and what power the complete Tianji Record truly holds.
choices.visible_cost: Master Mo may be unwilling to reveal the complete truth
choices.visible_reward: Obtain key clues and unlock new abilities
choices.risk_hint: Knowing too much may shake the Dao heart

text.content: Master Mo fell silent for a moment before finally speaking: 'The Tianji Record has nine pages, scattered throughout the Three Realms. The one in your hand is merely the first page. When the nine pages unite as one, you will possess the power to rewrite destiny—but the price is, you must endure the complete backlash of Heavenly Fate accumulated by all previous prophets.'

choices.text: Inquire About Sister Chen Nian's Whereabouts
choices.description: Directly ask about the location of Chen Nian's imprisonment and how to rescue her.
choices.visible_cost: Master Mo may not know the specific location
choices.visible_reward: Obtain clues about Chen Nian and strengthen determination to move forward
choices.risk_hint: There is a greater secret hidden on Chen Nian
choices.process_label: Chen Ji speaks his sister's name

text.content: When Chen Nian's name was spoken, Master Mo's remnant soul shuddered violently. 'Your sister... she is no ordinary sacrifice.' His voice suddenly became extremely complicated. 'She is the living vessel of the ninth page of the Tianji Record—the Holy Sect imprisoned her because one day they plan to sacrifice her completely, so the Tianji Record will disappear forever.'

choices.description: Since the intention is to shatter Heavenly Dao, no one—including Master Mo—can continue to control the Tianji Record.
choices.visible_reward: Completely control the Tianji Record and gain full usage rights
choices.risk_hint: Master Mo may have ulterior motives
choices.process_label: Chen Ji extends hand, rune blazing

text.content: Master Mo's remnant soul trembled slightly, seemingly not expecting such a demand from Chen Ji. After a long silence, he let out a bitter laugh: 'Very well... I have waited for this day far too long.' With those words, control of the Tianji Record silently transferred to Chen Ji, and Master Mo's soul grew even more faint.

choices.memory_label: 陈机夺取天机录控制权

text.content: When everything settled, Chen Ji slowly opened his eyes. In the real world, he still stood atop that barren mountain peak; the surroundings were exactly as when he left, as if the confrontation with the Heavenly Eye had been merely an illusory dream. Yet the rune slowly dissipating in his palm, and the warmth emanating from the Tianji Record in his arms, reminded him—this was all real. He had done it. He had truly touched that fourth path no one had ever traversed.

Wind blew from the valley, stirring his slightly disheveled hair. Chen Ji took a deep breath, feeling the rapid consumption of his Heavenly Fate Value—the series of operations just now had cost him at least half his lifespan. However, there was no regret in his eyes, only a tranquility after enduring countless hardships. He raised his head and gazed toward the distant horizon, where the outlines of the three major sects were faintly visible, along with the shadow of the Holy Sect of the Demonic Path beyond. The chess game of the world had just begun. And he, Chen Ji, had finally changed from a chess piece into a Chess Player.

Just then, the Tianji Record in his arms trembled again. He lowered his gaze to find the fourth light on the forbidden page had not dissipated; instead, it had condensed into a line of faintly visible text—'The second page lies at the bottom of the Abyssal Void.' Chen Ji stared at that line for a long moment, then suddenly let out a light laugh. He did not act rashly; instead, he took out a communication Jade Talisman from his arms and injected a strand of spiritual energy into it. A moment later, a familiar wave of demonic energy rushed over from afar—it was Ye Qing.

dialogue.content: You called me here, is there something? Ye Qing landed before Chen Ji, her beautiful face carrying a hint of wariness. I'm warning you, if you dare lie to me—

text.content: Demonic Path Mist, can you use it now? Chen Ji directly interrupted her, his tone flat as if asking about today's weather. Ye Qingwas momentarily stunned, then nodded. A meaningful smile curved at the corner of Chen Ji's lips: Then let's go, take me to the Abyssal Void. I'll show you something—something that can free you from the Holy Sect's control completely.

Ye Qing's gaze instantly changed; wariness mixed with barely concealed shock. She stared fixedly at Chen Ji's seemingly harmless face, trying to find any flaw. Yet those eyes were as calm as two ancient wells, bottomless, letting her not guess what thistrash disciple was truly scheming. After a long while, she finally spoke: 'Who exactly are you?' Chen Ji did not answer, merely turning to gaze toward the horizon; his silhouette stretched into a long shadow in the evening glow. The last page of the Tianji Record warmed slightly in his arms, as if responding to his heartbeat.
When Chen Ji's fingers touched the forbidden fourth light, the entire Tianji Record burst open—and the gaze of the Heavenly Eye crystallized into eternal fear in the same instant.
